title: Professional Content Rewriter
description: Rewrite any text to be more professional, clear, and concise while maintaining the original meaning.
prompt: Rewrite the following text to be more professional, clear, and concise. Ensure the tone is appropriate for a business environment and the main points are preserved: [TEXT]

title: Python Debugging Assistant
description: Expert python debugger that finds logical errors and suggests optimizations with explanations.
prompt: Analyze the following Python code for logical errors, performance bottlenecks, and potential bugs. Provide a detailed explanation of the issues and suggest optimized versions: [CODE]

title: Complex Data Summarizer
description: Transform complex datasets or long reports into a structured executive summary with key takeaways.
prompt: Summarize the following data/report into an executive summary. Focus on key metrics, main findings, and actionable takeaways. Use bullet points for readability: [DATA]

title: Sci-Fi Universe Builder
description: Generate a unique sci-fi setting with world-building rules, technological level, and major conflicts.
prompt: Create a detailed sci-fi world setting. Include its name, atmospheric conditions, technological advancement level (0-3 Kardashev scale), and the primary conflict currently facing its inhabitants.

title: Social Media Ad Copy Generator
description: Create high-converting social media ad copy for multiple platforms using a specific brand voice.
prompt: Generate three variations of high-converting social media ad copy for [PRODUCT/SERVICE]. The brand voice is [TONE]. Platforms: Instagram, LinkedIn, and X (Twitter). Include relevant hashtags.

title: SQL Query Optimizer
description: Analyze complex SQL queries and rewrite them for better performance and readability.
prompt: Optimize the following SQL query for PostgreSQL. Explain why the changes improve performance (e.g., index usage, subquery elimination): [SQL]
